Add deterministic regressions for fabricated confident facts/evidence and preserve valid stated/ambiguous/unreadable evidence, existing CP8 coverage, reportSessionId/ownership/payment boundaries, and all CP2-CP7 trust fixtures. Re-run exact-head install/lint/typecheck/tests/evals/build and hand the new exact head to Independent QA. This is failure cycle 2 on the CP8-01 grounding family; after a third repeated failure on the same root issue, stop and escalate rather than patch-loop. No paid/live eval or YELLOW/RED action authorized.
